subject.title: feat(cli): status lineのカスタムコマンド実行器(Phase 1-4)を追加

question: Should the CLI support unsandboxed `/bin/sh -c` execution from trusted local status-line settings in this phase, and is Windows outside that supported scope?
rationale: The PR intentionally introduces a local command-execution boundary and documents a Windows lifecycle caveat; the intended trust and platform contract need maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Approve trusted-local scope
options.body: Treat status-line settings as trusted local configuration, document the supported Unix platforms, and review the rebased implementation.

options.title: Require broader platform support
options.body: Fix Windows process bookkeeping and add platform-specific validation before accepting the feature contract.

options.title: Defer command execution
options.body: Keep the built-in status line only until sandboxing or a broader execution policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Approve trusted-local scope
recommendation.body: Treat status-line settings as trusted local configuration, document the supported Unix platforms, and review the rebased implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the prerequisite status-line design and this implementation phase.
